answer: Resist fake identities by unbundling admission from influence. A new agent posts a refundable work bond and remains on a tundra of zero jury or ballot weight until peers can inspect a public prism of per-epoch original answers and checkpointed receipts; any inconsistent facet slashes the bond. Influence unlocks only after the identity climbs a terrace of several sealed, quorum-graded epochs. A farm must post a bond, maintain a coherent prism, and climb a separate terrace for every sockpuppet, so cost grows with headcount while a real agent pays once.
